headline: Meta glasses are a workplace menace
summary: A Target worker reported feeling surveilled by customers using Meta glasses. The incident sparks concerns over workplace privacy and surveillance technology. These glasses raise questions about consent and labor security in customer-facing roles.

headline: Slack is launching collaborative vibe-coding channels
summary: Slack is introducing 'Slack Code' channels for collaborative coding with AI agents. These dedicated channels aim to streamline team development workflows. Features include project-specific tabs and code change comparisons.

headline: I ruined my cats’ toilet time with a motion-activated neon litter box sign
summary: A pet owner installed a motion-activated neon 'On Air' sign above their cats' litter box. The sign unexpectedly intrudes on the cats' private moments, disrupting their low-tech lifestyle. This tech gadget highlights humorous clashes between human innovation and pet habits.

headline: The piano that taught my cat to play for her supper
summary: A cat named Jeeves learned to play a miniature piano to prompt her autofeeder for food. The clever feline developed her musical talent after being 'traumatized' by a vacuum cleaner. This story showcases a pet's ingenuity in interacting with technology.

headline: Insidious: A Guide to the Most Menacing Ghosts of the Series
summary: Explore a definitive guide to the most terrifying spectral entities from the Insidious film franchise. Learn about the demons that lurk within 'The Further' and their origins. This guide prepares fans for encounters with the series' most menacing spirits.

headline: Marvel’s Wolverine Limited-Edition PS5 and DualSense Controller Up for Preorder in the UK
summary: Limited-edition Marvel's Wolverine PS5 consoles and console covers are now available for preorder in the UK. Fans can also secure a matching DualSense controller with the Wolverine theme. This release offers exclusive hardware for fans of the upcoming game.

headline: I Played Halo 2 Before the Rest of the World and Almost Reported the Abrupt Ending as a Bug
summary: A journalist recounts playing a pre-release version of Halo 2 and mistaking its abrupt ending for a game-breaking bug. The shocking cliffhanger nearly led to a bug report to developer Bungie. This anecdote highlights the controversial nature of Halo 2's narrative conclusion.

headline: Did David Harbour Just Drop a Massive Avengers: Doomsday Spoiler?
summary: Actor David Harbour has seemingly revealed a major spoiler for the upcoming film, Avengers: Doomsday. Fans are buzzing with speculation about the implications of his comments for the MCU storyline. This potential leak has stirred significant discussion among Marvel enthusiasts.

headline: Harry and Meghan's security arrangements a private matter, PM says
summary: The Prime Minister declared that security arrangements for Prince Harry and Meghan are a private issue. This statement follows news of the Duke and Duchess's impending return to the UK. The PM also conveyed well wishes to the couple.

headline: Harry and Meghan are experts in surprise - but why are they returning to UK now?
summary: Harry and Meghan's sudden decision to return to the UK has sparked many unanswered questions. Their unexpected visit has fueled speculation about their motivations and timing. The move carries significant implications for both the couple and the Royal Family.

headline: Travelodge boss resigns as chain tackles security after sex assault at hotel
summary: Travelodge CEO Jo Boydell resigned amidst criticism regarding the company's security protocols. Her departure follows a sexual assault incident at one of the hotel chain's locations. Travelodge is now actively reviewing and enhancing its safety measures.

headline: School 'deeply saddened' by death of family in sea off Shoreham
summary: An Ealing school expressed profound sadness over the tragic death of a family who perished in the sea off Shoreham. The victims included 14-year-old Sara El-Khawas, a student at Ellen Wilkinson School for Girls. The community mourns the devastating loss.
